question: Will the US and Iran reach a deal this month, yes or no?

lines.text: US officials say the military struck Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Monday.
Officials call it self-defence, not a return to major combat.
One official says Iran targeted a US aircraft, so the US hit the launcher.
A third official said: This was a defensive measure.
Iranian state media reported five explosions on the island.
The Wall Street Journal says it was one of a series of secret strikes.
A US naval blockade of Iranian ports continues, NBC says.
Before the war, the strait carried about a fifth of the world's oil and gas, The National says.
Brent oil rose about two percent to nearly one hundred and seven dollars, The National says.
A day earlier it fell over seven percent on hopes of a deal.
Iran's top negotiator Ghalibaf said the ball is now in America's court to prevent a war.

scene.quote: the ball is now in America's court

lines.text: Trump said on Monday: I don't know if you even call it a war.

scene.quote: I don't know if you even call it a war

caption: Qeshm Island, Iran, Hormuz: US officials say the military struck Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday in what they call self-defence after Iran targeted a US aircraft. Iranian state media reported five explosions, and Brent oil rose to nearly 107 dollars. Will the US and Iran reach a deal this month, yes or no?
